description.value:
You use your skills of your trade to inspect an object, hazard or creature for potential weak points, structural soundness, or material composition.

You Recall Knowledge on a creature, hazard or object with a skill that applies to this check. You must be at least trained in the applicable skill to analyze it. If it is a creature, you take a -2 circumstance penalty to this check unless you are trained in the skill that you would normally use to Recall Knowledge on the creature, such as Arcana or Nature.

On a critical success, you learn of the target’s immunities, resistances or weaknesses, as well as any potential qualities that are relevant (such as hardness on a construct). You do not learn any additional information. On a success, you choose one of these qualities.

Examples of applicable skills for a given creature or object might include:

  • Computers: Creatures with the Tech trait, computer-based machinery

  • Crafting: Creatures with the Construct trait, mechanical traps, building structures

  • Medicine: Organic creatures, poisonous traps

  • Thievery: Heavily armored or plated creatures, traps, chests

value.value: Expert in Computers, Crafting, Medicine or Thievery
